initial_design: uniform random sample of 12 candidate indices without replacement; existing reference seeds retained without an outcome-based seed search
model: model/bo_core.py; standardized 116-dimensional categorical feature kernel (12 NH base levels or 12 OH formulation levels, 8 solvents, and 96 interactions); normal–inverse-gamma Bayesian linear regression
acquisition: latent posterior mean + 1.96 * latent posterior SD; frozen posterior for each batch of 12
model_input_boundary: Only previously selected experimental response labels enter the BO policy or stop monitor. The candidate library includes two author-requested known reference formulations; the remaining ten identities are sampled without inspecting their responses. Candidate-library construction is reference-informed, not a response-blind discovery benchmark.

analysis_budget.actual_selected_counts: selections/plan_summary.json; stop earlier if the unchanged model rule is met

data_provenance: Original workbook bytes and the complete historical measurement/benchmark exports are retained unchanged; numerical selections do not establish dated laboratory chronology.
